details: The European Central Bank (ECB) is widely expected to keep its key interest rates unchanged at its upcoming monetary policy meeting on Thursday, July 23, 2026. This follows a 0.25 percentage point rate hike in June. Despite the anticipated pause, market participants and economists are closely watching for any signals of future policy tightening, with a significant probability of another rate increase in September due to persistent inflation pressures and rising energy prices in the eurozone.
title: ECB Expected to Hold Rates Amid Inflation Concerns

details: Recent US inflation data for June, released on July 14, 2026, showed a softer-than-expected Consumer Price Index (CPI) and core CPI, which initially triggered a rally in risk assets, including Bitcoin. However, a hawkish stance reiterated by Federal Reserve officials, combined with stronger retail sales figures and declining jobless claims, has dampened expectations for near-term Fed rate cuts. Furthermore, Brent crude oil prices climbing above $90 a barrel due to geopolitical tensions are reigniting inflation concerns, potentially pushing the Federal Reserve to maintain or even increase rates in the future, with a September hike now having a higher implied probability.
title: US Inflation Cools, But Fed's Hawkish Stance and Oil Prices Remain a Concern
